faults.page says: The November 2025 announcement quotes Hayo Apotheker as chair, but the museum's current who is who page (which already shows Eelco van der Lingen as directeur-bestuurder, so it postdates February 2026) lists the raad van toezicht as G.A. van der Steur, A. Birnie, L.W.J.M. Janssen, A.B. de Jong, S.J. Laverman and A.J. Soepboer, without Apotheker and without naming a chair

people.name: Eelco van der Lingen
people.title: directeur-bestuurder
previously: Conservator moderne en hedendaagse kunst, Fries Museum (2017 to 2019)

corrected.basis: The museum's who is who page and its November 2025 announcement name Eelco van der Lingen as director from 1 February 2026, after interim director Oeds Bijlsma; a January 2025 museum notice says Kris Callens left by mutual agreement with the board.

faults.page says: The only mention is 'Oprichter: Ed.R de Graaf' in a contact block on the visit page that still says the house is closed for corona measures and that a face mask is required, so it dates from 2020 to 2022; no current page (homepage, history, archive, FAQ) names him or says he still runs the house, and the brief lists a founder only when the founder still runs the space
